Within Method Results

Are school results within each analysis method
invariant to monotonic scale transformations?
In general, yes
With the exception of the Lord transformation, correlations of VAM
effects/residuals were all high (above 0.85). With three years of data
the correlations were all above 0.98 and above.
Correlations for median student growth percentiles across the 7
scales and 3 years were 1.0
The Lord Transformation “breaks” the VAM estimates because it
radically alters the interval nature of the scale.
Standardizing scores with layered VAM models obviates most issues
associated with non-intervalness.

D. Briggs & D. Betebenner Growth, Effectiveness, and Scale Transformation

Across Method Results

Fixing the monotonic scale transformation, are
school results across analysis method similar?
It depends.
With three years (2006/Grade 6) of data, the correlation between
median student growth percentiles and VAM effects/residuals
(SEP3ML3) were 0.91. Standardizing the percentiles increases
correlation to 0.95.
With 1 year (2004/Grade 4) and 2 years (2005/Grade 5) data, the
correlations were 0.72 and 0.84
Outliers suggest relationship with prior achievement, especially with
1 year (2004/Grade 4)

Within Method Results: Redux

What is the relationship between prior
achievement and the VAM effects/median SGP?
Correlation between median SGP and prior achievement (mean
theta, SEP3ML3) were 0.34, 0.18, and 0.31 in 2004, 2005, and
2006, respectively.
Correlation between VAM effects/residuals and prior achievement
(mean theta, SEP3ML3) were -0.11, -0.09, and 0.39 in 2004, 2005,
and 2006, respectively.
Still investigating why the dramatic switch in the VAM model.
What correlation passes the smell test?

Within Method Results: Redux

What is the relationship between school poverty
and the VAM effects/median SGP?
Correlation between median SGP and percent free/reduced lunch
were -0.42, -0.25, and -0.39 in 2004, 2005, and 2006, respectively.
Correlation between VAM effects/residuals and percent free/reduced
lunch were -0.15, -0.06, and -0.51 in 2004, 2005, and 2006,
respectively.
What correlation passes the smell test?
